metadata.title: Geodesic connectedness of globally hyperbolic spacetimes with a causal Killing vector field
metadata.abstract: We characterize the existence of a geodesic joining two prescribed points of a globally hyperbolic spacetime $(M,g)$ admitting a complete causal Killing vector field $K$ and a complete smooth spacelike Cauchy hypersurface $S$. We prove that two points $p,q\in M$ are joined by a geodesic if and only if there exists an $H^1$ curve $\gamma$ from $p$ to $q$ such that $g(\dot\gamma,K)$ is constant almost everywhere. The statement is intrinsic and allows $K$ to be timelike at some points and lightlike at others. A global splitting induced by the flow of $K$ is used in the proof, but no global bounds on the metric coefficients are imposed. The proof relies on stationary perturbations of $(M,g)$, whose relevant compactness properties follow from global hyperbolicity of $g$, and on uniform estimates based on an integral admissibility condition and a Glaeser-type inequality. Two examples illustrate geodesic connectedness and the obstruction detected by the characterization.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.progressType: 具有因果Killing场的全局双曲时空测地连通判据
analysis.workSummary: 对具有完备因果Killing场K和完备光滑类空Cauchy超曲面的全局双曲时空，证明给定p、q可由测地线连接，当且仅当存在从p到q的H¹曲线使g(γ̇,K)几乎处处常数。K允许在不同点类时或类光，证明虽用K流诱导的整体分裂但不要求度量系数全局界。
analysis.breakthrough: 以坐标无关的可容许曲线条件刻画两点测地可达性，覆盖K因果类型可变的情形。
analysis.limitations: 这是给定点对的等价判据，不声称所有这种时空自动测地连通；K及Cauchy超曲面的完备性均需保留。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。实际PDF SHA-256与本次记录一致；共16页，页数一致、文本完整提取、无短文本页。标准与点写A.I./A. I.、断行/连字符模型名称（含Danus）和AI用语补检未观察到作者自身使用披露；无披露不等同未使用AI。

analysis.priorityReason: Lorentz几何与变分测地线理论直接相关。
